implemented: One Streams::State-owned native byte queue with ordered error/EOF observations and pending logical CRLF state. All Context read_bytes/read_char/read_text/read_line, old byte read alias and leased Operation.read use it under one existing input lease.

Private Step 24 native refill only; no competing OS input path. 4096-byte queue blocks are allocated before native consumption, and logical cursors commit only after owned result construction. Allocation/size failure preserves bytes without rollback allocation.

Shared utf8.hpp lead-width factoring and existing complete-scalar validator authority. ASCII/NUL/BOM, 2/3/4-byte scalars and all tested transfer partitions; strict overlong/surrogate/range/continuation/truncation handling.
Maximal immediately available invalid-prefix consumption using nonblocking recovery lookahead; next legal starter retained, precise partial/error offset, never invalid result text.

LF/CR/CRLF logical lines, immediate standalone CR without following-byte probe, pending LF only consumed by a later line read. Mixed raw/char/text returns raw terminators; zero or failed empty reads preserve continuation.

Available complete text without waiting to fill capacity; following incomplete scalar remains entirely queued when a valid prefix can already be returned. Final unterminated line before EOF; ordered EOF observation can be followed by a later host-stream read.

One original request deadline, complete native/partial/cleanup progress, session-only control failures do not poison other Runtime sessions; buffered state survives independent close. Step 24 best-effort entered-syscall/NativeSafe/precise-root/lifetime contracts unchanged.
Future native encoding errors are queued events consumed once, distinct from decoder-generated recovery errors. No Step 26 wide adapter or public source console API implemented.

strict_sanitizers.configuration: RelWithDebInfo, pinned LLVM/Clang 19.1.7, existing RTTI-off vptr exclusion
strict_sanitizers.execution: Outside restricted ptrace runner for actual LeakSanitizer checking. No sanitizer/leak error; existing invariants/fatal children and negative leak controls remain enabled. No assertion or safety check disabled.

checks.note: Native child counters are recorded per case; no total inferred from variable kernel split/short-read behavior.

queue_contract.ownership: One shared native queue per Streams; state accessed under the existing exclusive input lease, not per-Runtime or competing read-ahead buffers. Native Adapter remains trusted embedding boundary. All public read routes use this queue.
queue_contract.transaction: Queue retains OS-read and logical prefix bytes until success/error result storage is constructed. Exception restores logical consumption implicitly; no allocation required to roll back. Pending control marker is scoped to its original request.
queue_contract.text_result: Valid UTF-8 text on success; empty text and raw partial on error. completed counts logical raw bytes including stripped delimiters/skipped CRLF LF. error_offset is invalid-prefix start in partial, or end for native/control errors. Unconsumed read-ahead remains queued.
queue_contract.invalid_prefix: Consume invalid sequence and immediately available non-starters; use only polling probes after invalidity is known, preserve the first legal scalar starter. Do not wait for a future recovery byte.
queue_contract.available_text: Return current complete scalars up to count; after a valid prefix, leave a following incomplete scalar entirely queued rather than wait for it. No complete scalar yet waits under the original deadline.
queue_contract.line_continuation: CR immediately completes. Only a later logical line read may skip a following LF; raw/char/text clears continuation only on actual byte consumption. Zero and failed empty reads preserve it.
queue_contract.EOF: Pending EOF is observed after queued bytes or truncation error. Deliver a final nonempty unterminated line once before EOF. Delivered EOF does not permanently close/refuse future host native reads, preserving Step 24 behavior.
queue_contract.failure: Native errors remain ordered after their payload; raw partial consumed before failure is always returned. Already-disclosed incomplete UTF-8/line bytes are not secretly reassembled on retry. Original native and secondary cleanup codes preserved.
